steps.title: Define App Metadata and Configuration

steps.description: Specify collections for user wallets, transactions, game rounds, deposits, withdrawals, and financial distribution allocations.

steps.title: Establish Application Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Configure activities, internet permissions, hardware acceleration, and material theme in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Color, Style, and Vector Graphic Assets
steps.description: Design aviation-style dark themes, metallic silver accents, glowing reds, aircraft shapes, and button backgrounds.

steps.title: Implement Synthesized Audio and Sound Engine
steps.description: Develop native AudioTrack and ToneGenerator synthesis for engine hum, win chime, countdown, and crash alerts.

steps.title: Implement Backend Network Client
steps.description: Build asynchronous HTTP client for TrumpleDroid generic cloud API handling auth, session tokens, and CRUD data.

steps.title: Develop Aviation Multiplier Flight Canvas
steps.description: Construct high-performance animated custom View rendering real-time parabolic flight path, aircraft sprite, and rising multipliers.

steps.title: Implement Authentication Screens
steps.description: Build user registration with ₹50 welcome promotional bonus initialization, login, and secure credentials management.

steps.title: Implement Primary Navigation & Game Dashboard
steps.description: Create the main flight arena with live multiplier tracking, bet placement, cashout logic, sound toggles, and round histories.

steps.title: Implement Wallet and Deposit System
steps.description: Build real-time balance manager with ₹100-₹20000 quick selections, custom amounts, and bonus accounting.

steps.title: Implement Payout & Withdrawal Module
steps.description: Provide UPI ID and Bank Account payout requests with input validation, transaction reference generation, and status flow.

steps.title: Implement Transaction History & Audit Ledger
steps.description: Develop full categorized financial ledger with date, transaction reference, type badges, and net balance delta displays.

steps.title: Implement Administrator Dashboard & 60/40 Allocation System
steps.description: Create executive dashboard for audit metrics, withdrawal approvals, and 60% Owner / 40% Winner distribution calculations.

steps.title: Implement Settings and Responsible Gaming Hub
steps.description: Build volume sliders, audio switches, age verification policy, terms, privacy guidelines, and logout controls.

steps.title: Building ArbajSbz
steps.description: Compile, assemble debug APK and finalize all aviation gaming modules and business logic.
